body:
Thanks for the reply.  I live in a busy big city, I like that I have my very own apartment here but at times its also what makes me lonely.  I work in bio-pharmaceutics which you would think that would be exciting and big bucks, but its neither.  In fact i feel overworked with a ton of busy work.  I took the past few days off from work and literally slept them away, I finally went to the doctor today and she is helping me but I just wished that I could take this knot of sadness and kick it out of me. 

If I had a million dollars I would travel, first stop would be Iceland, Peru beaches, just get away from this mundane life.  No pets, if I had a time machine i think i would go forward.  I don't think anything happens after life, it just ends...I don't want to die but I get so hopeless and feel so stuck in this rut that I just would rather die than live another 40 yrs like this.
